name: com.motion-brew/motion-brew
title: Motion Brew
description: 100 free animated React components for Tailwind CSS v4: search them and install any as one file.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find motion-brew components by what they do, in plain words: "hold to delete", "sidebar navigation", "animated number", "3D tilt card". Returns the best matches first, with slug, trigger, engine and a one line summary. Start here.

query.description: What the component should do or be

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List all 100 motion-brew components with slug, trigger, engine and a one line summary. Filter by trigger (what sets the animation off) or by engine.

trigger.description: Only components set off by this interaction

engine.description: Only components that use this animation library

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Everything needed to add one component, fast: one shell command that installs its npm packages and downloads it as a single self contained .tsx file (animated icons and the cn() helper inside), plus a usage example and the props. Run the command rather than writing the file out. Pass files "single" only if you cannot run shell commands.

files.description: "none" (default) gives a command that downloads the file; "single" includes the file's contents, for agents without a shell

tools.name: get_install_plan
tools.description: Plan adding several components at once: one install command for every npm package they need, and where each file goes with its download command.

tools.name: get_setup
tools.description: What a project needs for the components: React 18 or 19 and Tailwind CSS v4, plus notes on dark mode and reduced motion.
